what_is_here: The values every figure in the manuscript draws, one CSV per figure, plus the figures themselves. Model output beyond that stays on the platform it was computed on; see README 'Data policy'.

data.aou_covid: All of Us Controlled Tier CDR v7 C2022Q4R13, cutoff 2022-07-01
data.aou_influenza: All of Us Controlled Tier CDR v9 C2025Q4R6, cutoff 2025-01-01

frozen_analysis_runs.note: Model fits live in the All of Us Researcher Workbench workspace bucket and on Quartz. They are not mirrored here; only the aggregate values the figures draw are.
frozen_analysis_runs.aou_v7_5domain_split: employment split, influenza Wald tests, eFigure 3 offsets
frozen_analysis_runs.aou_v7_5domain_mi40: multiple imputation at m = 40, and the Black-race attenuation under imputation
